haikus.haiku:
Sliced bologna sighs
Golden grill sparks heat softly
Melted cheese waves bright
Happy #NationalBolognaDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Warm tripe simmering
Spices dance, steam curls soft bright
Tasting joy in bowl
Happy #WorldTripeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft cake scent rises
Laughter echoes like bright bells
Candles flicker warm
#HappyBirthdayKevinKline from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft night stars flicker
Moonlit rivers glow, hearts sing
Fireflies soft dance bright
Happy #WelcomeToScorpioSeason from @ClamBakeSanta
